title: Spanish Cocido Madrileno Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Madrid, featuring tender meats and vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cubed bread and cook until lightly toasted, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced porcini mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, red wine, vegetable broth, and cocido.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with crumbled fermented cheese.
